confidence_notes: Overall medium. Beer, coffee and meal anchors draw on several Bergen-focused aggregator sites (Expat Arrivals, MyLifeElsewhere, Gotripzi, Combien Coute) dated 2025 to 2026, not specific to July; beer assumes about a 0.5 L draught. Cocktail rests on a few small-sample or undated figures, cross-checked against beer. No Bergen by-the-glass wine price was found, so wine uses an Oslo house-wine range (roughly NOK 100-170) and about 1.2 times the beer price. NOK converted at an approximate 9.5 NOK per USD, not a retrieved rate. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for July peak season; no accommodation search was run and no listings were checked. RBA rate taken from search-result summaries, not opened directly; 2026-11-19 not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed for food and drink, which use Bergen-specific data points; Oslo was used only as a secondary Norwegian check for wine. Accommodation is a holistic estimate reflecting Bergen's high summer demand and Norway's high price level, not a comparable-city dataset.
